camera.edge_guard_rule: retain the exact source camera-target writer and route-state transition; no x-only, kill-count, or fixed-frame substitute is admitted

captured_first_segment_operands.countdown_tick_rule: decrement once per controller update while phase is 2

coffee_shop_guard.phase4_follow: x_lower=u16(A5+0x278) each tick; clamp at 0x03f0 before the next phase

initialization.handoff_rule: the route-2 to route-4 handoff consumes the first source camera controller update before the first route-4 frame is presented
initialization.mutation_control: skipping the handoff camera update leaves source frame 2238 at x=640 instead of x=648
initialization.route_table_bounds: 0x0b0526 indexes four signed bounds by u16(A5+0x1e8)<<2

player_follow_guard.players: three 0x100-byte records at A5+0x380, ascending slot order

world_to_plane_order.rule: finish player/navigation, encounter camera-bound writes, and camera controller; then translate source scroll2 through the accepted strip origin and derive scroll3 through the accepted measured scroll2-to-scroll3 bridge; submit both VDP2 planes last

x_target_arithmetic.clamp_order: apply signed delta to target, clamp upper at +0x36, then lower at +0x34
x_target_arithmetic.commit_order: target +0x20 -> position +0x10 -> A5+0x278 global bound -> A5+0x32 camera position

z_target_arithmetic.clamp_order: apply signed delta, clamp upper at +0x30, then lower at +0x32

up_obstacle_removed.authority: terrain boundary remains independent of obstacle actor

navigation_bodies.scheduler: record type 20 at 0x01bc38, fixed-pool ascending-slot order
navigation_bodies.scope_boundary: this closes geometry/navigation ownership only; destructible damage, pickup/hazard and presentation authority stay in their declared families

minimum_penetration.axis_guard: resolve z only when unsigned z_penetration < unsigned x_penetration; otherwise resolve x
minimum_penetration.contact_bits: x sets bit 2/3; z sets bit 0/1 in player+0x5d from penetration sign
minimum_penetration.x: x_half-abs_x; negate when obstacle center delta was negative
minimum_penetration.z: z_half-abs_z; negate when obstacle center delta was negative

implementation_contract.overlap_guard: abs((obstacle_x + signed x_center)-player_x) < x_half AND abs((obstacle_z + signed z_center)-player_z) < z_half

player_geometry.rule: 0x01db8a reads no player rectangle; substituting a player hurt box is forbidden

state_0200.guard_true: state += 2 and bind selector 4 release record at 0x016518

state_0400.writes: scan four parent+0x78..0x7e u16 child slots and clear the matching child pointer

collision_damage.health_arithmetic: s16(0-25)=-25, then source KO clamp writes -1
collision_damage.overlap: strict per-axis rectangle overlap using the sum of player-attack and obstacle-hurt half extents

camera_sample_order.mutation_control: using post-player camera_x_position allocates 0xffb380 one frame early (native 2245 instead of source 2246)
camera_sample_order.native_rule: scheduler guard uses camera_x_previous; camera_x_position is the post-player sample for the next source frame
camera_sample_order.source_rule: scene-record guard samples A5+0x278 before the same source frame's player/camera controller write

spawn.guard: nonnegative record threshold 688 <= unsigned camera bound A5+0x278, route/lane record filters pass, and the record-20 pool allocation succeeds

state_0200.damage_guard: current player attack record 0x11af76 subtracts 25 from signed health 0, clamps to -1, and writer 0x01d4aa sets state/substate 0x0400/0x0000

state_0400.entry: increment low state byte to 0x0402, set timer high byte to 8, bind selector 1 record 0x06e14a, and submit
side_effect_order: 0x0bc692 presentation transaction consumes one shared RNG value
state_0400.timer_guard: decrement high byte of actor+0x2a while nonzero; after zero require negative animation branch

arithmetic: when flag bit0 is clear: fp60 += s16(field30)<<8; fp68 += s16(field34)<<8; field34 += s16(field3c)
when flag bit1 is clear: fp64 += s16(field32)<<8; fp6c += s16(field36)<<8; field36 += s16(field3e)
set flag bit0 when u16(fp68.high) < u16(parent reference field18); set bit1 by the same guard for fp6c

direction_control.rule: only when actor+0x4f is zero negate field30, field38, field32, and field3a; actor+0x0f must not control trajectory sign

state_0404.initialization: selectors 2 and 3 seed two alternating animation/position records plus signed velocity and acceleration fields
state_0404.position_select: (u8(A5+0x19)+D7)&1 selects the first or second record

transition_initialization_order.rule: after the state-0x0402 timer is zero and the animation branch is negative, increment substate to 0x0404, call 0x06e010 and 0x06e0b2 in the same actor update, then submit

state_0404.visible_projection: 0x06e0b2 copies only the selected channel x/y high words plus its animation, assembly, timer, branch and selector identity into the visible actor fields

scope: Round 1 player navigation, terrain, obstacles and camera bounds

control_bytes.name: retry_selector
control_bytes.rule: copied to A5-0x6144; 0xff repeats record selection

control_bytes.name: reserved
control_bytes.rule: not read by 0x0b1baa..0x0b1c08 or the reachable handlers

2.movement_rule: branch 0 uses remainder=world_z&15 and adds positive u8(field5)-remainder to world_z; branch 2 uses remainder=(~world_z)&15 and subtracts positive u8(field5)-remainder from world_z; either response clears z_velocity and sets response=1

4.movement_rule: x_remainder=(orientation==2?world_x:~world_x)&15; candidate=(x_remainder>>shift)+u8(field5)+1; z_remainder=(~world_z)&15; penetration=candidate-z_remainder; if penetration>0 then world_z-=penetration, z_velocity=0, response=1

6.movement_rule: z_remainder=(orientation==1?world_z:~world_z)&15; slope=z_remainder-s8(field5); if slope<0 then world_x-=((world_x&15)+1), x_velocity=0, set retry selector 0xff, and restart selection; otherwise candidate=slope<<shift; x_remainder=world_x&15; if x_remainder>=candidate then world_x-=(x_remainder-candidate+1), x_velocity=0, response=1
6.parameter_signedness: field 3 is u8; fields 4 and 5 are s8

implementation_contract.scheduler_order: player movement -> global bounds -> actor/obstacle response -> terrain resolver -> camera/route controller -> world-to-plane submission

bounded_packed_grid.derivation: row-major source cells sampled at each 16-pixel tile origin; four 2-bit selector codes packed least-significant code first

six_fields.name: kind
six_fields.rule: even byte offset into 0x0b1c0a handler table

six_fields.name: branch_selector
six_fields.rule: byte offset into the selected kind table; bit index is selector >> 1 when nonnegative

six_fields.name: orientation
six_fields.rule: kind-4/kind-6 axis orientation selector; kind-2 does not read it

six_fields.name: shift
six_fields.rule: variable word shift count for kind-4/kind-6

six_fields.name: x_parameter
six_fields.rule: zero-extended for kind-2/kind-4; sign-extended for kind-6

six_fields.name: z_parameter
six_fields.rule: zero-extended for kind-2/kind-4; sign-extended for kind-6
